title: Woven weighted exponentials
summary: Let $f$ and $g$ be nonzero functions in $L^2([0,1])$. The \emph{woven weighted exponential system} (associated with $f$ and $g$) is defined by $$\Wc(f,g)=\bigset{\set{fe^{2πi nt}}_{n\in J} \cup \set{ge^{2πi nt}}_{n\in J^c}\,|\,J\subset\Z}.$$ We say that $\Wc(f,g)$ is \emph{wovenly complete}, (resp. \emph{wovenly minimal}, a \emph{woven frame}) if the weaving $\set{fe^{2πi nt}}_{n\in J} \cup \set{ge^{2πi nt}}_{n\in J^c}$ is complete, (resp. minimal, a frame) for all $J\subseteq \Z.$ In this paper, we study conditions that imply certain approximation properties of $\Wc(f,g)$, such as…
